question: How diverse are seeds 101 through 108 in the listener-preferred melody writer?
conditions: Presets and composer fixed; whole arrangements vary with seed. Models use full unmodified renders. Listening uses first-chorus excerpts with linear loudness matching per preset.

subjective.prior_feedback: The user explicitly preferred the c6711de melody candidate to the preceding writer. No human ratings have been supplied for this new seed cohort.
subjective.protocol: Independently shuffled A-H per genre; seed and model scores initially hidden; same eight-bar first chorus, linear loudness matching to -23 LUFS. Per-song preference/groove/memorability 1-5 and per-genre perceived diversity 1-5, all initially blank.

audiobox.scoring: Existing aesthetics.py score function unchanged; model handles 10-second windows across complete WAV, duration-weighted final partial window.

clap_preprocessing.normalization: none; native CLAP clips to [-1,1] and quantizes to int16
clap_preprocessing.window_selection: equally spaced first-to-last complete window; one segment uses center
clap_preprocessing.aggregation: unweighted mean of valid excerpt cosines

normalization.method: Five-millisecond edge fades, then linear gain to common integrated LUFS target per genre; no limiter
